QuestInfo.name: Phantom Reunion
QuestInfo.1: You finally met Phantom in the Leafre Secret Storage Room. You didn't expect a warm welcome, but he started to attack you out of nowhere. Maybe it was that lock you broke. First, get him under control.
QuestInfo.2: There was no welcome, unless you count beatings. Phantom must be mad about that broken lock, or embarrassed that you found Aria's picture. Though he seems more than just angry...
